body.message: ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: more than 50 rows in one action (cascades included)

nextSteps.text: Do not split the write to get around the limit, and do not retry it as it is.
Tell the person the write touches more than 50 rows, cascades included, and ask whether to run it in held batches.
Do this only on an explicit yes: write in batches of at most 50 rows, same intent and run; the person approves each batch.

body.personMessage: The agent's write touches more than 50 rows (cascades included). It will ask you whether to run it in batches of up to 50 rows; you approve each batch with your passkey.
